headline: Flagler win at last as conference play opens
dek: Flagler drew all three of their matches outside the conference, then won at Georgia Southwestern on the day conference play opened. North Georgia, the only other side still unbeaten, were held at home by Lander.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: North Georgia's fourteen goals are more than USC Aiken and Lander have scored between them, and eight different players have shared them.

wire.line: Clayton State won at Middle Georgia State on opening night and have now scored twelve goals from five different scorers.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches have passed their date with no published result, among them Clayton State's visit to Oglethorpe and Middle Georgia State's to Columbia on 22 August.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Javier Gongora Andres has scored six of Middle Georgia State's eleven goals from twenty shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Theo Hoang has scored five of Georgia Southwestern's eight goals from nine shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Kalle Kuisma has conceded twice in Clayton State's goal this season.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Lander's six goals have come from five different scorers.

last_match.line: North Georgia stay unbeaten; Lander have drawn as often as they have won and lost together.

next_match.line: Flagler have yet to lose this season; Clayton State's only defeat came at Florida Tech.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
